acceptanceCriteria: an LRF run on a cem/0.3 map refuses before any patch path runs, with a message that names the cem/0.3 profile first, pinned by a test
A cem/0.3 map with no legacy patch returns a refusal naming cem/0.3, not patch-unavailable.
A cem/0.3 map with supplied or default patch never reads that patch before profile refusal.
Existing CEM 0.1/0.2 LRF conformance tests remain passing.
body:
Filed 2026-09-25 from the PR #238 follow-up section. A local review flow (LRF) given a cem/0.3 map takes the cem/0.1 out-of-band patch path before it refuses the profile, so the refusal it reaches does not name the unsupported profile. The profile check should run first and the refusal message should name the profile.

Audit addendum 2026-09-26 (WIRE-01), source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a: A structurally valid cem/0.3 map passed to lrf without --patch is parsed successfully, then causes discovery of .git/corvint/change.patch. Missing legacy patch produces patch-unavailable instead of naming unsupported cem/0.3. Callers receive the wrong recovery instruction and can waste work supplying a patch that this profile cannot consume. This is a refusal diagnostic/ordering defect, not observed false acceptance.
Source: internal/lrfrepo/adapter.go:78; internal/lrfrepo/adapter.go:122; internal/lrfrepo/adapter.go:170; internal/cem/wire/map.go:183.
Verification: ["Pinned binary 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a against isolated temporary repository; copied stable.cem02.json with spec changed to cem/0.3; exit 2, empty stdout, stderr code patch-unavailable (wire-repro/result.json).", "Focused Go packages internal/cem/wire, internal/cem/verify, internal/lrf and internal/lrfrepo passed."]
Correction: Dispatch on supported LRF CEM profiles immediately after ParseMap; refuse cem/0.3 with the unsupported profile named before repository/patch discovery. Preserve 0.1/0.2 verification ordering.
See .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md and .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/ for original evidence. This addendum does not claim implementation or promotion.
title: LRF given a cem/0.3 map takes the cem/0.1 out-of-band patch path before refusing the profile
